definition: The MAtrixware REsearch Collection (MAREC) is a standardised patent data corpus available for research purposes.
details: MAREC seeks to represent patent documents of several languages in order to answer specific research questions. It consists of 19 million patent documents in different languages, normalised to a highly specific XML schema. MAREC is intended as raw material for research in areas such as information retrieval, natural language processing or machine translation, which require large amounts of complex documents. The collection contains documents in 19 languages, the majority being English, German and French, and about half of the documents include full text. In MAREC, the documents from different countries and sources are normalised to a common XML format with a uniform patent numbering scheme and citation format. The standardised fields include dates, countries, languages, references, person names, and companies as well as subject classifications such as IPC codes. MAREC is a comparable corpus, where many documents are available in similar versions in other languages. A comparable corpus can be defined as consisting of texts that share similar topics – news text from the same time period in different countries, while a parallel corpus is defined as a collection of documents with aligned translations from the source to the target language. Since the patent document refers to the same “invention” or “concept of idea” the text is a translation of the invention, but it does not have to be a direct translation of the text itself – text parts could have been removed or added for clarification reasons. The 19,386,697 XML files measure a total of 621 GB and are hosted by the Information Retrieval Facility. Access and support are free of charge for research purposes.

explainer.lead: MAREC is a standardized patent data corpus available for research, holding 19 million patent documents in 19 languages. It matters as raw material for retrieval, NLP, and machine translation research that needs large volumes of complex documents.

tiers.eli5: It is a huge library of patent documents from many countries, organized in one consistent format so researchers can work with it.
tiers.practitioner: Engineers use it to train and test systems on realistic, multilingual, long-form documents. The pitfall is the domain skew: patents differ sharply from general text, so results may not transfer.
tiers.paperLevel: The MAtrixware REsearch Collection (MAREC) is a standardized patent data corpus for research, consisting of 19 million patent documents in different languages normalized to a highly specific XML schema. Most documents are in English, German, and other languages among the 19 represented.

explainer.example: A translation team trains a model on MAREC's patent documents across languages and evaluates it on held-out patents.
